note.zh-TW: 網站補充的延伸科目。期末若有大量沒用完的用品，實務上可以列為資產；本課金額小，直接列費用。
note.en: An extension account added by the site. In practice a large stock of unused supplies at period end can be recorded as an asset; the course expenses supplies directly because the amounts are small.

definition.zh-TW:
期末盤點後還沒用完的事務用品，以成本列為流動資產。

它和事務用品費是一體兩面：買進的用品用掉的部分是費用，還沒用掉的部分可以列為用品盤存。
definition.en:
Office supplies still unused at the period-end count, recorded at cost as a current asset.

It is the other side of office supplies expense: the supplies used up are an expense, while the unused remainder may be recorded as supplies on hand.

example.zh-TW: 位置：資產負債表流動資產，預設停用。課程把事務用品全額費用化，所以故事不會用到它。期末調整時用品盤存增加、事務用品費減少。
example.en: Where it sits: current assets on the balance sheet, disabled by default. The course expenses all office supplies, so the story never uses it. At the period-end adjustment this asset rises and office supplies expense falls.

misconception.zh-TW: 以為沒用完的用品一定要列成資產，否則就是做錯。金額不重大時直接列費用是常見的簡化做法。
misconception.en: Believing unused supplies must always be shown as an asset or the accounts are wrong. Expensing them is a common simplification when the amount is immaterial.
